versions.changelog: Jellyfin 12.4 build of Kevinjil/Jellyfin.Xtream master (0.8.1 + fixes from January 2026) with the Jellyfin 12 support from Kevinjil/Jellyfin.Xtream#301: .NET 10, and VOD, series and catch-up playback fixed for 12.x. 0.8.3: Xtream API requests are spaced at least 500 ms apart, so the daily guide refresh no longer trips provider flood protection.
